在消費級硬體上建構 Supervisor-Worker 分層式本地 AI 叢集，: Built a Supervisor-Worker tiered local AI cluster on consumer-grade hardware, achieving a low-cost, high-privacy, high-availability private inference environment.
為什麼要自建本地 AI 叢集？: Why Build a Local AI Cluster?
雲端 API 方便，但成本不可控、資料外洩風險高 &mdash;&mdash;: Cloud APIs are convenient, but costs are unpredictable and data privacy risks are high — I chose to build my own AI inference environment on consumer hardware.
雲端 API 月費快速累積，日常使用成本不可控: Cloud API monthly fees accumulate rapidly, making daily costs unpredictable.
對話資料傳送海外，企業場景下隱私與合規風險高: Sending conversation data overseas creates serious privacy and compliance risks in enterprise contexts.
依賴單一雲端供應商，服務中斷即業務停擺: Relying on a single cloud provider means any outage halts business operations.
缺乏端到端監控，無法掌握推理延遲與資源使用狀況: Lack of end-to-end monitoring makes it impossible to track inference latency and resource utilization.
建構 Supervisor-Worker 分層架構，大模型做規劃、小模型做執行: Build a Supervisor-Worker architecture: large models for planning, small models for execution.
實現全棧 MLOps 監控：任何節點異常立即告警: Implement full-stack MLOps monitoring: instant alerts on any node anomaly.
撰寫完整 ADR 與維運手冊，確保系統可追溯、可維護: Author complete ADRs and maintenance manuals to ensure full system traceability and maintainability.
不採取「全負載單一模型」方案，而是將任務依複雜度分級：: Instead of a "single model under full load" approach, tasks are classified by complexity:
異常時由中樞 100% 接管。: Central hub takes 100% control upon anomalies.
Telegram Bot &mdash; 6 組關鍵告警規則即時推送: Telegram Bot — Real-time pushes for 6 key alert rules
任何一層失敗，自動降級到下一層，確保服務不中斷：: Automatic fallback to the next tier upon failure, ensuring uninterrupted services:
DeepSeek V4 Flash &rarr; Pro &mdash; 本地全: DeepSeek V4 Flash → Pro — Fallback when local is offline

成功在單台 24GB 記憶體設備內運行 35B 等級的大型模型。: Successfully ran 35B-class large models on a single 24GB RAM device.
相比傳統稠密模型，推論速度提升，且耗電量大幅降低，適合 24/7 待機。: Increased inference speed and significantly reduced power usage compared to traditional dense models, ideal for 24/7 standby.

內建計費與流量限制 (Rate Limiting)，並與 Grafana 整合實: Built-in rate limiting and cost tracking, integrated with Grafana for real-time API invocation monitoring.
形成一套永不斷線的算力保險機制：: Forming an always-on computing insurance mechanism:
極速推理，由 Mac M4 主機承擔 90% 以上請求。: Fast inference, with Mac M4 host bearing over 90% of requests.
當主機過載時，自動溢流至本地其他 Linux / PC 算力節點。: Automatically overflows to local Linux/PC computing nodes when the main host is overloaded.
本地全數不可用時，自動切換至 OpenAI / Groq 等雲端 API 備援。: Automatically switches to OpenAI/Groq and other cloud APIs when all local nodes are unavailable.
Mac M4 作為運算中樞運行 35B 主模型與 Hermes Agent，透過: Mac M4 serves as the computing core running the 35B main model and Hermes Agent, balancing loads via LiteLLM Proxy. 3-tier Fallback ensures service uptime; local processing rate exceeds 95%.
